question: Does restoring the precompression Clifford maps uniquely reconstruct the charged field dynamics and select the Maxwell bridge from the retained native data?
kills: Infer unique charged-sector time from a finite even algebra, its automorphism group and its retained ground state.
Infer the relative central sector weight from the KMS condition on an even direct-sum algebra alone.
Identify the nonlocal charged-boson induced response with a uniquely fixed bare local Maxwell coefficient.
assumptions: Finite complex family Clifford algebra with fixed chirality-preserving Spin action for the exact counterexample.
Odd Clifford maps are granted algebraically; no identification with physical local fermion fields.
Already stipulated 9R+1L equal-velocity compact gauge candidate for the Maxwell comparison.
Fixed zero-mode sector and nonzero momenta for the Gaussian background response.
leaves_open: Native physically graded charged-field extension and localization.
Common source state and time or sourced block-exchanging symmetry.
P1/P2 derivation of compact gauge connection, measure, coefficient and channel content.
Common 3+1D physics, matter, gravity, alpha-functional and initial-state derivation.
not_claimed: All counterfamily members satisfy every original P1/P2 or full clock constraint.
A universal no-go for TFPT or an infinite observable net.
DR reconstruction applies directly to this finite algebra or this chiral 1+1D candidate.
New discovery of Clifford, Gibbs or Schwinger theory.
Independent external peer review or complete physical closure.
summary_de: Die bedingte statische Clifford-Vervollstaendigung rekonstruiert keine eindeutige geladene Zeit: Delta Pminus ist an der ganzen geraden Dynamik unsichtbar und veraendert die ungerade Zweipunktfunktion. Sogar derselbe invariante Grundzustand bleibt erhalten. Volle Gibbs-Sektorgewichte koennen den Offset bedingt rekonstruieren; die KMS-Bedingung allein nicht. Der Maxwell-Koeffizient bleibt im gegebenen Randkandidaten ein separates Datum. Kein Gegenbeweis gegen das gesamte P1/P2-System.

literature.scope: Observable net and superselection data, not finite-block reconstruction.
Declared Schwinger gauge normalization and mass relation, not TFPT origin.
